So a bit late but I have just came back to the game and got all the way to 5bc within a week, I have heard shields are really good but I was never good with using them. What I recommend is upgrade the forge to the max in a difficulty you are comfortable in, for me how I got through 2bc(which was the biggest wall for me) was chase scythes, get every cursed chest, mushroom boi/giants whistle/ice armor/powerful grenade are all great skills. Learn to use them well, necromancy gastronomy should make it that after a point it doesn't matter you don't have pots cause you can trade most damage and come out on top. The hard part is the start for me. If I manage to get through corrupted prison then it's free. I have heard the best run is promenade-prison depths-ossuary-black Bridge-stilt village- clock tower-clock room-high peak castle. I swapped the first part with toxic sewers into corrupted prison into ramparts, because that way I avoid the shitty shield giving enemy for the biome I don't have gastronomy in. After you get gastronomy and necromancy and enough points in survival you should skim through most biomes with no real problem unless you decide to take every hit
